items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1972-09-13
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Louie Nelson; the interviewer introduces the name 'They had Louie Nelson' in the context of a group of musicians.

ctx.x: Yeah. And that's what we used to wind up every morning. And a gang of us, you know. Playing till daybreak. Each of us a ton, you know. What's this boy's name? He died. He was a saxophone player. He died. He had a brother playing slide and fly and bone. Two brothers. I forgot their name. It's been so long, you know what I mean? Did he stay here or did he go away? No, he was playing here. Well, let's see. Let's see. Do you know what I'm getting here? I'm getting here. I'm getting here. I'm getting here. I'm getting…

I'm getting here. I'm getting here. I'm getting here. I'm getting here. What are they? Let's see. They had Louie Nelson. They had Sport Young and Boots Young. I'm not going to do it, Nelson. Not the Youngs. Boots and Sport. They played? They played.
